Definition: feminine of a compound of G4012 and G2776; encirclement of the head, i.e. a helmet:--helmet.
BiblicalUsage: Perikephalaia is a helmet, the encirclement of the head. Paul tells believers to put on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation — and to take the helmet of salvation with the sword of the Spirit.
TheologicalSignificance: What I believe is that hope is a helmet: it guards the head that thinks, and the sword in the hand is the word of God.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
